version: d1-3B in Liquid AI's System One Arcade, Quick Draw demo (no account)
feeds_on: A drawing, a camera frame or text, plus typed questions
free_tier: Free demo, no account; model free to download
launched_note: Open weights released 7 Oct 2026; model page created 5 Oct 2026.
test: One round of Quick Draw (6 random words of 16, 20 seconds each). We drew each word with our own simple line drawing, stroke by stroke with a scripted mouse, prepared before the test and never tried on the model beforehand.

conditions.value: Our own line drawings of the 6 words it asked for
Stroke by stroke with a scripted mouse, at about human speed
Liquid AI's free demo page, in a web browser

runs.result: missed: top guess apple at 75%, below the 85% it needs

seconds_note: The game's own timer: average of the 5 guessed words (6.8, 7.1, 10.6, 12.1, 9.9 s) from the word appearing to the guess; includes our drawing time.
verdict_reason: Free, no account, and it read 5 of our 6 simple drawings while we were still drawing them. It missed the apple even though apple was its top guess: it stayed at 75%, under the 85% the game needs.
lesson: Small AI can be fast and good at picking from a short list. It is a demo of what is coming to apps, not an app you will use every day.
use_for: Seeing how fast small AI has got

deductions: wrong subject (no guess made in 20 s) -20

score.notes: Image drawer. Quality (5 x 50 + 30) / 6 = 46.7, rounded 47. Speed: 9.3 s average, under 30 s = 15. Free plan: no login 5, no published limit 10, demo only 1 = 16. Price: not published = 3.

credits: Drawings: our own simple line drawings (scripts/quickdraw_strokes.py).
